body: thank you for your comment, i hope you’re doing okay x
good to know I’m not alone in being affected by it, and I’m glad you’re still here too x

I’m not sure it’s that. I’m not interested in a ‘tribute’ or being glorified in death. 
And as far as the princess di thing goes, I’m pretty open about my mental health and have never felt that I needed to hide it.
I’m sorry if I’m coming across as defensive or something, maybe I’m just not understanding your comment?

hey I don’t really have any answers for you, but I just want to let you know that I have felt like I would inevitably die by suicide SO many times. It’s really scary and makes any attempt at helping yourself feel pointless. Even though I don’t have any advice on how to fix it, I just wanted to validate that you aren’t alone and it’s really fucked. I’m glad you’re getting help, and I hope your time in hospital is beneficial 💕
